passages.text: The laser cutter certification is Laser Safety Level 2. Contact the evening supervisor for help.
The resin printer cleanup fluid is isopropyl alcohol. Contact the resin technician for help.
The wood lathe minimum stock length is 120 millimeters. Contact the woodshop lead for help.
The vinyl cutter maximum sheet width is 52 centimeters. Contact the print coordinator for help.
The embroidery machine approved needle is Size 75 embroidery needle. Contact the textile mentor for help.
The electronics bench solder temperature is 340 degrees Celsius. Contact the lab monitor for help.
The ceramic kiln cooldown duration is 18 hours. Contact the kiln operator for help.
The waterjet station booking limit is 90 minutes. Contact the fabrication manager for help.
The metal brake maximum sheet thickness is 2 millimeters. Contact the metals instructor for help.
The photo scanner image format is TIFF. Contact the media desk for help.
